public_rationale: The claim says GitHub Copilot was losing money when it had about 1.8 million paid users, in late 2024 to early 2025. The speaker relies on a WSJ report, citing one anonymous source, about losses in early 2023. In November 2023 GitHub's CEO said the opposite: per-user running costs were below the price, and margins were 'growing positive'. Both sources predate the target period and conflict. I found no disclosure or credible report of Copilot's profit or loss for October 2024 to February 2025. Microsoft does not break out the product's finances. So the claim cannot be confirmed or refuted for the period it describes.
limitations: Later reporting (2025–2026) on Copilot margin pressure from heavy users falls outside the target period and was not used.
The CEO's margin claim is unaudited and may cover serving costs only.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: GitHub Copilot, like all generative AI products, loses money despite 1.8 million paid customers.

statement.excerpt: Microsoft said a year later that Github Copilot had 1.8 million paid customers, which is pretty good, except like all generative AI products, it loses money.

from_speaker: Github Copilot had 1.8 million paid customers
a year later (than the October 2023 WSJ report)
like all generative AI products, it loses money
'loses Microsoft money even when the user pays' (same passage)
our_interpretation: Plain reading: around the time GitHub Copilot had about 1.8 million paid subscribers (late 2024) and up to the post, the product's costs exceeded its revenue. That is, it was loss-making on a product basis, including on paying users.
The 1.8 million figure is background, not the claim being tested.
Target period: October 2024 to February 2025, from the 1.8 million figure 'a year later' than October 2023 up to the post. The claim is in the present tense with no period named.
criteria.support_condition: Credible reporting or disclosure that GitHub Copilot's costs (serving costs, at least) exceeded its revenue during October 2024 to February 2025.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Credible reporting or disclosure that GitHub Copilot had positive margins (revenue above serving costs) during October 2024 to February 2025.
